title: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement

messages.subject: Quote from Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH: Renewal of the ball bearing 6306 agreement
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are pleased to present our current offer for your requirements, maintaining our commitment to supporting your business with top-quality service and our extensive product range.

For this offer, we quote a price of €4.96 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net and a contract term of 12 months. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

To provide some background on our pricing calculations, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 10 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C2815 rose 0.8 % in twelve months and is 65 % of our cost.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

messages.subject: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – multi-year proposal for 6306-2Z C3
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for your offer. You have told us that only multi-year volume agreements change prices, so we propose a 36-month or 24-month agreement at 20000 pieces per year. Three alternative packages are attached.

Our forecast fc:360020@2026-09 records a 4.2 % increase in demand for this bearing. Your scorecard sc:70620@2026Q3 shows 302 ppm, above your 150 ppm standard commitment. The same scorecard shows on-time delivery of 85.0 %.

Could you confirm the 7-day lead time for the full term? Do you offer a cheaper variant of the 6306-2Z C3?

If your authority is limited, please arrange an authorized pricing review.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Renewal ctr:4600070620 – multi-year proposal for 6306-2Z C3
messages.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the quality record data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We also checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. That does not change our position.

We welcome your proposal for a 36-month agreement and can offer a revised price of €4.94 per unit, with Zahlungsziel 90 days net and a contract term of 36 months. We must, however, maintain our standard 30-day payment terms. Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net, we can offer a price of €4.88 per unit, with a contract term of 36 months.

From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.26 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.08 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.05 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision. Our specialists will separately address your questions regarding lead times and alternative bearing variants. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH

Logistics: We have free capacity for your parts. Our Lieferzeit is 7 days. With overtime we can deliver in 7 days, at a premium.

messages.subject: Renewal 6306-2Z C3 – 36-month agreement, 90 days net
messages.body:
Dear Mr Gruber,

Thank you for the revised offer and for confirming the 7-day lead time.

We are offering exactly the multi-year volume agreement you described as the basis for price changes. That is 20000 pieces per year over 36 months, or alternatively 24 months, with 90 days net. Our packages are attached.

In June your owner offered to take us through your calculation of hourly rates and material. We would welcome that walk-through, together with an authorized pricing review of this commitment.

Could you also send a separate written quote for the cheaper material-grade variant you mentioned, so our engineering team can assess it?

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

messages.subject: Re: Renewal 6306-2Z C3 – 36-month agreement, 90 days net
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Thank you for your ongoing partnership with Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH. We note your request for a walk-through of our calculations and a separate quote for the alternative material grade, which our respective teams will address. 

Please note that material accounts for about 65 % of our cost; more detail we do not share. From our calculation: a cheaper material grade would save about EUR 0.26 per unit; a wider tolerance would save about EUR 0.08 per unit; doubling the lot size would save about EUR 0.05 per unit. Each needs your engineering approval and a new drawing revision.

We therefore maintain our offer of €4.94 per unit for a 36-month agreement with 90 days net payment terms. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Florian Gruber
Inside Sales, Wälzlager-Zentrum Süd GmbH
